$comment: ADDITIONAL check, not a substitute for testdata/vectors/bulk-write-categorization.json. That family (47 curated cases, each documenting one rule) is the committed oracle and is consumed by tests/bulk_write_categorization_vectors.rs. THIS file is 600 *randomised* write sequences generated from the same upstream function at the same pin, and it exists because randomised sequences reach combinations no curator writes down: 318 of them produce at least one error and 466 batch two to four rows against the same document state. Retire it only if the shared family grows randomised cases.
